kind: CPU process recovery test with mocked Slurm commands; no real Slurm mutation
checks: Numeric diagnostic step only; rejects foreign allocation, batch, extern, and allocation-only IDs
Step name padding is stripped; explicit %100j display width requested
Numeric marker fallback recovers a truncated displayed step name
Independent file opens cannot acquire duplicate flock
Real local coordinator reaches SIGSTOP and resumes after controller SIGTERM
Real local diagnostic and simulated remote processes both exit before SIGCONT; mocked scancel receives only 99999.7

read_only_slurm_check.observation: Existing batch step name printed at explicit 100-character width

limitations: Slurm scheduling/cancellation itself is mocked in recovery test
Real borrower lifecycle monitored separately by the parent task
Controller survives owner termination by design; simultaneous SIGKILL of controller is not covered
